Best Effort.description: The demanding nature of a knight protector's calling drives him to extraordinary focus. Starting at 2nd level, once per day he may add a bonus to a single skill check. He must declare use of this ability prior to rolling. The bonus increases by 1 for each three levels gained beyond 2nd.

Defensive Stance.description: Whenever a knight protector begins his turn adjacent to (within 5 feet of) an ally with fewer Hit Dice, he may shift up to 2 points of his own Armor Class to that ally, reducing his AC by the same amount. The maximum AC he can transfer rises by 1 at every third level after 1st.

Iron Will.description: Upon reaching 2nd level, the knight protector receives Iron Will as a bonus feat.

No Mercy 1.description: At 6th level, the knight protector can make one additional attack of opportunity each round, as though he possessed the Combat Reflexes feat with a Dexterity modifier of +1. At 9th level, this increases to two additional attacks of opportunity per round. This benefit stacks with Combat Reflexes.

Retributive Attack.description: When an ally of a 10th-level knight protector is knocked unconscious or rendered helpless, the knight protector may immediately strike back at the responsible creature. On this retributive strike, he adds his Charisma bonus (if any) to the attack roll and inflicts an extra 10 points of damage on a hit. He can perform a number of these strikes per day equal to his Charisma bonus (minimum one), but no more than one per round. Multiple retributive strikes against the same opponent are permitted.

Shining Beacon.description: The knight protector serves as a living symbol of noble purpose. Any ally standing within 10 feet of him receives a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects. This benefit is lost if the knight protector becomes paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated.

Supreme Cleave.description: From 3rd level onward, a knight protector may take a 5-foot step between attacks when utilizing the Cleave or Great Cleave feat.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Members of this prestige class gain proficiency with tower shields.
